capture.coverage_note: CU1 request produced raw ATT and occupancy for SE0/SE1 but instruction-wave JSON only for SE0. CU2 was captured separately. Do not describe this as whole-GPU or two-SE instruction coverage.
capture.flydsl_input: original SHUFFLE-5D paged KV, random valid page table, zero-padded tail
capture.opus_input: equivalent logical linear KV constructed before launches, explicit packed group-mode OPUS
capture.reference: independent FP32 reference; rtol=atol=0.02; max absolute output error 0.0009247958660125732 for both original kernels and both diagnostic variants
capture.warnings: No incomplete wave used; every wave num_stitched equals num_insts. ATT dispatch durations are not used as ordinary benchmark times.

method.cta_grouping: Eight waves per sequential generation; all four SIMDs and slots0/1, starts within512 cycles, all333 barrier completions within64 cycles. This identifies CTA cohorts for this one-CTA-resident workload, not a general interpretation of wave id.
method.steady_region: Aligned workgroup barrier intervals7+8*t+s with t=1..38,s=0..7, corresponding to logical phases2..39. Excludes first and final logical phase.
method.reported_means: Mean over sampled CTAs within each capture, then equal-weight mean across captures.
method.stall_semantics: On gfx9 ATT latency=stall+issue. Per-wave stall totals overlap between waves and must NOT be added as kernel-time attribution.
method.mfma_union_model: Union of [attempt+stall, attempt+stall+32) for each native BF16 32x32x16 MFMA on the two waves of each SIMD. Explicit execution-window model, not a hardware utilization counter.
method.scope: Explains measured code/path differences and sampled CTA stage costs; does not assign every microsecond of global runtime to a specific instruction.

resources.note: Registers and LDS from ELF/ISA metadata. rocprofv3 CSV showed encoded VGPR128/SGPR112 and LDS150016; these are not the source register counts. Both target kernels are nonpersistent.

no_tail.change: Process-local replacement of _mask_v_tail with identity on zero-padded performance data only.
no_tail.not_correct_for_supported_api: This removes NaN-tail protection. It is diagnostic only, not a usable optimization.

packed_v.change: Process-local _read_v variant: bitcast each 8-BF16 LDS read to 4 i32 words; concatenate all32 i32 words before a single BF16 vector store, instead of repeatedly storing individual BF16 slices. Tail mask, page table, math and barriers are retained.
packed_v.validation: 24 independent FP32-reference cases: D128/D192 x full-noncausal/full-causal/SWA128+sink x KV64/65/128/777 with Q257 and NaN tails; three bit-exact launches per case. Not a replacement for the complete173-test suite.

diagnostic_ablations.conclusion: Packed-V representation is an experimentally confirmed contributor. Exact LLVM optimization pass responsible for the extra BFI is not identified. The actual tail branch remains in IR/ISA; it was not converted into unconditional masking.

uninstrumented_confirmation.protocol: Same process and logical inputs, preallocated outputs; initial100 paired warmups, five alternating rounds,20warmup/100iterations/run_perftest,num_rotate_args1. No ATT/PMC enabled. All three outputs pass independent FP32 reference.

persistence.current_8wave: No persistent work queue or CTA work loop. Noncausal fixed head/batch/qblock grid. MERGE handles at most two causal head/tail Q blocks, not general persistence.
persistence.current_4wave: Static path is nonpersistent; dynamic path has an atomic ticket queue and while batch_index<batch_size loop.
persistence.opus_d192_group: Nonpersistent fixed grid, same640CTAs for the target.
persistence.implication: Missing persistence cannot explain a scheduling-mode difference between these two baselines. Persistent work assignment may reduce setup/reassignment overhead but does not increase LDS-limited resident waves; benefit has not been measured.
